about: Dodo Payments for development builds (test mode). Only values that are not secret: the hosts, the two Pro product ids and the business id. The founder fills in the ids after making the products in Dodo's test mode; the test checkout host is still to be found (check V0 in docs/design/2026-10-31-dodo-payments-spec.md). Every address must be https. paymentsOn stays false until the founder switches payments on (F25).
